title: Average Calculator
description: Calculate the average (mean) of up to five numbers.

faqs.question: How is average calculated?
faqs.answer: Sum of all entered numbers divided by how many numbers were entered.

faqs.question: Do I have to fill all five fields?
faqs.answer: No — leave unused fields at 0 and they'll still be included in the count. For fewer numbers, use 0 for unused entries.
